tools.name: quantura_search_markets
tools.description: Find a stock ticker such as NVDA, a currency pair, a prediction market, a FRED series such as UNRATE, or a public SageMaker forecast. Use source=fred for economic data.

tools.name: quantura_describe_dataset
tools.description: Inspect columns, units and required dimensions for an economic_series source from Search. Select a single series before download or forecasting. FRED supports series_id and optional vintage_date; historical forecasts cap the vintage conservatively to avoid revised-data look-ahead.

tools.name: quantura_forecast_models

tools.name: quantura_get_forecast

tools.name: quantura_verify_forecast
tools.description: Verify saved forecast content against its vBase timestamp receipt. This verifies content and time, not accuracy or historical publication before the receipt timestamp.

tools.name: quantura_create_forecast
tools.description: Forecast a ticker for a specified horizon and obtain quantile ranges. Creates an asynchronous job, uses compute and saves a request in your account. tools.name: quantura_ask_scout

tools.name: quantura_my_access
tools.description: Read your current API access and permissions.

Stocks view=home selects the homepage feed; view=full selects the full universe. date=to

tools.description: Use the same import service as Upload CSV in Quantura market search. Store privately for the uploader or a currently authorized Clerk organization. tools.description: Read original columns, values, supplied metrics and provenance from an authorized uploaded CSV or public catalog ID.

tools.name: quantura_resolve_market_link
tools.description: Resolve exact HTTPS polymarket.com, polymarket.us or kalshi.com event/market links into venue-specific outcomes. International Polymarket is download-only sampled-price history.

tools.name: quantura_option_expiry_horizons
tools.description: Get Alpaca-listed expiries, calendar days since the downloaded close date, and projected trading periods. Counts use XNYS regular sessions; weekly/monthly grids may not land on an expiry. Not an option trading/exercise deadline.

tools.description: Compute the ZIP-compatible dated quantile inversions, rolling observed-close sample variance (ddof=1), nearest quantile and ranges of every column. tools.description: Requires alerts:read and datasets:read plus current CSV access. Returns only your subscription. Uses completed raw IEX regular-session daily closes; no recipient address is exposed.

One email per matching new trading date; 90-day expiry. Quantile rules require daily rows and use the same New York date, skipping

tools.description: Creates a private Google spreadsheet in the authenticated user’s linked Google account. Requires sheets:export scope, Google drive.file consent and source download permission. Preserve request_id when retrying; uncertain creation is never duplicated automatically. Does not share the Google file with

tools.name: quantura_export_csv_workbook
tools.description: Creates a private Google workbook with a tab per source and a summary Index. Requires datasets:read, sheets:export, current download permissions and Google consent. Use the same IDs, title and request_id for retries.

tools.description: Administrator only. Validate a SageMaker Canvas CSV and preview its original columns and quantiles before publishing. No GitHub write. Requires sagemaker:publish scope.

Makes its contents viewable and downloadable by other users through Search. Preserves source CSV bytes and quantile columns. Preview first. This writes a Git commit; requires sagem

tools.name: quantura_get_weather_forecast
tools.description: Get the NOAA National Weather Service point forecast with temperatures, valid periods and published precipitation probabilities. U.S. government open data (public domain).

tools.name: quantura_get_current_weather
tools.description: Read a recent nearby station observation separately from the forecast. NOAA National Weather Service U.S. government open data (public domain).

tools.name: quantura_get_weather_alerts
tools.description: Read active official NOAA National Weather Service alerts for one U.S. point. U.S. government open data (public domain).

tools.name: quantura_get_alphafold_prediction
tools.description: Read existing structure metadata and reference links for the GFP (P42212) or human myoglobin (P02144) teaching example. AlphaFold DB data CC BY 4.0. Includes links to UniProt and, for GFP, the RCSB PDB archive (CC0).

tools.name: quantura_analyze_structure_confidence
tools.description: Summarize pLDDT and available predicted-aligned-error evidence for the GFP (P42212) or human myoglobin (P02144) teaching example. AlphaFold DB data CC BY 4.0.

tools.name: quantura_search_docs
tools.description: Search public Quantura Mintlify guides and get cited results for authentication, MCP, forecasts, science and API usage. Public documentation, all rights reserved.

tools.name: quantura_quantum_simulate
tools.description: Run a bounded ideal CPU statevector simulation. Supports a documented subset of OpenQASM 2, up to 10 qubits, 160 gates and 4,096 shots. Quantura implementation, MIT.

tools.name: quantura_quantum_resource_estimate
tools.description: Count input qubits, gates, depth, explicit T gates and ideal statevector memory. Quantura implementation, MIT. Fault-tolerant estimates require a separate hardware model.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: quantura_list_screener_forecasts, quantura_set_csv_close_alert · Private data: quantura_get_screener_forecast, quantura_list_private_csvs, quantura_export_csv_google_sheets, quantura_export_csv_workbook, quantura_get_alphafold_prediction, quantura_analyze_structure_confidence · Public sink: quantura_import_csv, quantura_set_csv_close_alert, quantura_export_csv_google_sheets, quantura_admin_preview_canvas, quantura_admin_publish_canvas · Destructive: quantura_set_csv_close_alert, quantura_quantum_simulate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: quantura_list_screener_forecasts, quantura_set_csv_close_alert · Private data: quantura_get_screener_forecast, quantura_list_private_csvs, quantura_export_csv_google_sheets, quantura_export_csv_workbook, quantura_get_alphafold_prediction, quantura_analyze_structure_confidence · Public sink: quantura_import_csv, quantura_set_csv_close_alert, quantura_export_csv_google_sheets, quantura_admin_preview_canvas, quantura_admin_publish_canvas · Destructive: quantura_set_csv_close_alert, quantura_quantum_simulate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
